scope: 调用前动态权限撤销、审批版本校验与撤销事件审计

checks.name: tool_loop_verifier_blocks_revoked_approval
checks.evidence: approved decision followed by verifier denial produces tool.authorization_revoked and zero ToolRuntime executions

checks.name: fixture_runtime_fails_closed
checks.evidence: revoked authorization snapshot returns tool_authorization_revoked before fixture side effect

checks.name: sqlite_revoke_persists
checks.evidence: approved approval becomes cancelled and remains cancelled after SQLite close/reopen

checks.name: revoke_is_idempotent
checks.evidence: repeating revoke returns changed=false and conflict=already_revoked without a second state mutation

checks.name: http_route_and_event
checks.evidence: HTTP revoke route returns cancelled approval, one tool.authorization_revoked event, and idempotent replay

checks.name: typecheck
checks.evidence: TypeScript syntax and workspace type checks passed

boundaries: Does not kill an already started operating-system process.
Does not add a global listener or background task.
Does not compare providers or claim real-model quality.
Does not implement automatic background retry or full project-scoped projection.
